pages.text: The sun sets on the sea. Down below, the reef glows soft and blue.
Coral the clownfish wriggles into her anemone. Sway, sway, sway.
The seahorse wraps his tail around a seagrass stem and closes his eyes.
The turtle drifts by, slow and sleepy, going home.
The crab scuttles into a shell and pulls the door shut.
The parrotfish blows a soft bubble blanket and snuggles inside.
The octopus turns from red to grey and tucks all eight arms in.
The starfish holds on tight to a rock. Goodnight, starfish.
A school of tiny silver fish flickers past, then goes still.
The moon shines down through the water in silver ripples.
The reef is quiet. Only the sea says shhh, shhh.
Coral yawns a tiny bubble. Sway, sway, sway. Goodnight, reef.
